Text clean-up.

- `kebab_case(v)`: lowercase words joined by hyphens, for URLs, CSS classes and file names
- `extract_hashtags_mentions(v)`: the #hashtags and @mentions in a text, each once, without the symbol; email addresses and numeric codes are skipped
- `normalize_quotes(v)`: curly quotes, dashes, the minus sign, ellipses and special spaces as plain ASCII, with zero-width characters removed

74 functions in all. Every test case passes with the Rhai engine on GitHub and in a Neblex Code step.
